gazette_location.description_raw_en: thoroughfare between No. 343 and 345 Des Voeux Road West, commencing at its junction with Des Voeux Road West running in a north by north-westerly direction for about 48 m and terminating at its junction with Connaught Road West as shown coloured pink on drawing No. HH 4204;
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道起點與德輔道西三四三及三四五號之間連接，向西北偏北伸展約四十八米，然後與干諾道西連接。其位置在HH 4204號圖則上用粉紅色標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: cul-de-sac commencing at its junction with Victoria Road almost opposite to No. 55 Victoria Road running in a north by north-westerly direction for about 45 m then west by west-southerly for another 280 m and terminating at a turning circle off I.L. 1891 as shown coloured pink on drawing No. HH 4205.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此盡頭路起點與面對域多利道五十五號處連接，向西北偏北伸展約四十五米，然後向西南偏西伸展二八○米，至內地段一八九一號對開圓形轉彎處止。其位置在HH 4205號圖則上用粉紅色標明。
